title: Classic PCAP protocol decode and flow table
description: Parse a project-generated classic PCAP containing Ethernet, IPv4, TCP, UDP, DNS and HTTP records into a canonical flow table.

inputs.generation: pcap-project-generated-v1: eight classic-PCAP records, little-endian microsecond header, Ethernet link type

oracle.policy: Every canonical flow-table byte and all structural counters must match the independently frozen reference output.
oracle.deadCodeDefense: The complete 208-byte canonical result is compared and SHA-256 hashed.

work.tolerance: All counters and all canonical output bytes match exactly.
